info.title: Performance Beef Consultant API
info.description: Authenticate via POST /api/consultant/tokens/ using OAuth 2.0 client credentials to obtain a Bearer token. Attach the token as Authorization: Bearer {access_token} on all data requests. Tokens expire after 1 hour.

get.summary: List all feedyards you have access to

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: Filter results to specific feedyards. Omit to return all accessible feedyards.

parameters.name: users_filter_by
parameters.description: Whether the values in Users are feedyard IDs or email addresses.

errors.description: Partial errors present alongside data on 200 responses when some feedyards could not be accessed.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing, malformed, or expired token. Obtain a new token and retry.

429.description: Too Many Requests - includes a Retry-After header indicating seconds to wait.

500.description: Internal Server Error - retry after a brief delay.

get.summary: Feed delivery records by date range

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Beginning of the date range (inclusive). Defaults to 10 days before end_date.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the date range (inclusive). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: Comma-separated feedyard IDs or emails to filter by. Tip: use the Users endpoint to retrieve your feedyard IDs.

parameters.name: users_filter_by
parameters.description: Whether the values in Users are feedyard IDs or email addresses.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include or exclude. See Field Filtering reference for dot-notation support.

parameters.name: field_filter_mode
parameters.description: Whether the Fields list is an allowlist (include) or blocklist (exclude).

feed_deliveries.description: Date-keyed dictionary - keys are ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), values are arrays of delivery objects for that date.

items.description: Field filtering applies only to fields within these delivery objects.

errors.description: Partial errors present alongside data on 200 responses when some feedyards could not be accessed.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing, malformed, or expired token. Obtain a new token and retry.

429.description: Too Many Requests - includes a Retry-After header indicating seconds to wait.

500.description: Internal Server Error - retry after a brief delay.

get.summary: Group and closeout performance per feedyard

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: Comma-separated feedyard IDs or emails to filter by. Tip: use the Users endpoint to retrieve your feedyard IDs.

parameters.name: users_filter_by
parameters.description: Whether the values in Users are feedyard IDs or email addresses.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include or exclude. See Field Filtering reference for dot-notation support.

parameters.name: field_filter_mode
parameters.description: Whether the Fields list is an allowlist (include) or blocklist (exclude).

parameters.name: closeout_grouping
parameters.description: Controls how closed-out groups are counted - whole closeout, only onfeed days, or only sold days.

parameters.name: group_status
parameters.description: Filter groups by their current status.

groups.description: Field filtering applies only to fields within this array. Each element is a group object whose properties are { label, value } objects - not raw scalars. Access the display label via .label and the raw value via .value.

items.description: Every property on this object follows the shape { label: string, value: string }.

errors.description: Partial errors present alongside data on 200 responses when some feedyards could not be accessed.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing, malformed, or expired token. Obtain a new token and retry.

429.description: Too Many Requests - includes a Retry-After header indicating seconds to wait.

500.description: Internal Server Error - retry after a brief delay.

get.summary: Daily pen-level records over a date range

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Beginning of the date range (inclusive). Required.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the date range (inclusive). Defaults to today.

parameters.name: users
parameters.description: Comma-separated feedyard IDs or emails to filter by. Tip: use the Users endpoint to retrieve your feedyard IDs.

parameters.name: users_filter_by
parameters.description: Whether the values in Users are feedyard IDs or email addresses.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include or exclude. See Field Filtering reference for dot-notation support.

parameters.name: field_filter_mode
parameters.description: Whether the Fields list is an allowlist (include) or blocklist (exclude).

parameters.name: projected_weight
parameters.description: Include projected weight calculations. Note: significantly increases response time.

pen_history.description: Field filtering applies only to fields within this array.

bunk_score.description: Shape depends on the feedyard's bunk-scoring configuration. When the feedyard is configured for one bunk score per pen, returns a scalar (string or null). When configured for per-meal scoring (the default), returns an array of one entry per meal slot.

projected_weight.description: Only present when the projected_weight request parameter is true. Float when a value is determined, null otherwise.

errors.description: Partial errors present alongside data on 200 responses when some feedyards could not be accessed.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing, malformed, or expired token. Obtain a new token and retry.

429.description: Too Many Requests - includes a Retry-After header indicating seconds to wait.

500.description: Internal Server Error - retry after a brief delay.
